title: FILM frame interpolation
description: Local FILM frame interpolation for short project clips. The graph reads a project video, interpolates frames with a multiplier, and writes a new muted video at the chosen output frame rate. The output frame rate must be set to source FPS x multiplier to keep the duration unchanged.

requirements.name: film_net_fp16.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Install the FILM FP16 frame interpolation file and verify its SHA-256; review the model license before use.

evidence: GPU-qualified 2026-10-19 on ComfyUI 0.37.0 / RTX 4090: the exact template graph interpolated a 320x180, 16 FPS, 17-frame testsrc2 source (SHA-256 d877c754873751e17596d91e1fa91850ec9f81363459e0e1fa23877b5f4eaa58) with multiplier 2 and output FPS 32 to a 32,211-byte H.264 MP4 (SHA-256 656294eba3d03e30685f383201899956a03105847b83f3112bc4f6f3b1058ce2) with 33 frames, 32 FPS and 1.031 seconds in 4.1 s (prompt e1f7d75b-1ec6-4fe3-adda-7e6bcf5621e8). This proves graph execution, frame multiplication and output structure. Interpolation artifacts, perceptual quality, temporal consistency, longer clips, memory limits and offline behavior are not proven.
